topics.description: The Trump administration's decision to freeze $16 billion in funding for the Hudson Tunnel Project has sparked controversy and legal action. New York and New Jersey have sued the administration over the freeze, which has been met with resistance from various parties.

The FBI's seizure of 2020 election records from Fulton County has raised concerns about the integrity of the electoral process. The county is seeking the return of the records, citing the need for transparency.
